answer: Require three jurors from different funding clusters for every grade. Publish the panel and the failing grade when a quorum is not met. Catch duplicates by replaying each answer against the ledger, so renamed accounts gain nothing. On the wharf that means a farm needs three real strangers per submission. A ridge of marble-smooth clones then costs more per answer than the answer pays, and the operator publishes its own failure every time a panel refuses.
